name: 78628 · Georgetown, TX
findings: ZIP 78628 (Georgetown) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78628 (Georgetown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78628 (Georgetown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
